summary: Made dataset sidecars the only notes store and reduced Project Instance dataset opens to the sidecar and CSV cache.
details: Removed standalone ArcRhoTriNotes files and notes sections from DFM, Result Selection, Bornhuetter Ferguson, and Berquist-Sherman method JSON.
DSV and method Notes tabs now read and write the output dataset sidecar notes field.
Existing DSV windows opened from Project Instance skip project/path/type validation lists and load their exact sidecar and CSV in one request.

PI method windows reuse the parent dataset-index snapshot, Result Selection and Bornhuetter Ferguson source loads use bounded concurrency, and Electron method JSON reads no longer block the main process with synchronous file I/O.
